t: An open-source 3D-printed humanoid robot for research and education.
steps: Find the Poppy Humanoid repository hosted by Poppy Station.
Read the build guide and check the full cost with school leaders.
Print the parts on a 3D printer.
Assemble the robot. The repository says an experienced builder needs about 7 hours.
Flash the system image to the Raspberry Pi 3 or 4.
Install the Python library with pip on a computer.
Test each joint with a short script before running longer moves.
